newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE TO HEAD FOR 5,050-5,080 REGION.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE TO HEAD FOR 5,050-5,080 REGION.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index looks set to head for 5,050-5,080 region on Thursday it maintains the upward thrust from the start of the week, technical analysts said.
Positive momentum in London on Wednesday as well as a record closing high on Wall Street should provide the environment for some rousing action in blue-chip UK stocks, they added.

But a little caution may appear around 1100 GMT when the Bank of England is expected to announce its decision on UK interest rates and unless rates go up more than expected, the upward streak by the stock market will not be stopped just yet.
By 0720 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 1.6 at 5,027.8.

On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrials shot up 71.77 points to 8,259.31 -- a new closing high. By achieving this, a short-term downtrend on the Dow has been removed which had consisted of lower intra-day highs over the past three days. The next upward target for the Dow is 8,300.
Short-term momentum is not as strong for the Dow as it is on the FTSE but if the Dow continues its run, this will still provide the impetus to send the FTSE hurtling up, analysts said.
